security_audit.summary: All 24 static findings are false positives: 22 match Markdown code formatting, and two match ordinary UI descriptions. content.user_title: Choose the Right Unity UI Framework
content.value_statement: Unity projects can mix UI frameworks, making implementation choices unclear. This skill explains framework differences and routes requests using existing project patterns.
actual_capabilities: Routes explicit framework names, file extensions, and Unity UI component references to the appropriate specialized skill.
Guides project inspection using UXML, USS, UIDocument, Canvas, RectTransform, and editor method clues.
Answers conceptual questions about Unity UI architecture and framework selection without routing.
Distinguishes runtime and editor requests when a project contains multiple UI systems.
Applies default framework choices when project evidence and user preferences are absent.
Identifies unsupported automated Figma imports and offers description or screenshot alternatives.
limitations: Implementation depends on separate ui-uitk, ui-ugui, and ui-imgui skills, which are not included in this package.
Automated Figma design import is unavailable through this skill.
Project-specific framework detection requires access to relevant Unity project files.
Visual UI requests do not include interaction scripts unless the user explicitly requests them.

use_cases.title: Choose a Framework for a New Game Menu
use_cases.description: Identify preferences and project constraints before routing a new runtime menu request to the appropriate framework skill.

use_cases.title: Route a Custom Inspector Request
use_cases.description: Check existing editor UI patterns and choose UI Toolkit or IMGUI for an inspector or editor window request.

use_cases.title: Compare Unity UI Options
use_cases.description: Get a conceptual comparison of UI Toolkit, uGUI, and IMGUI without changing project files.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Frameworks
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the main differences between UI Toolkit, uGUI, and IMGUI for Unity interfaces. Do not change any files.

prompt_templates.title: Select a Runtime UI Framework
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a settings menu for a new Unity game. Check existing UI patterns and ask about missing preferences before choosing a framework.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: choose a framework before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Route an Existing Layout Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: My inventory screen uses UXML and USS. Route a spacing adjustment to the appropriate specialized skill without adding interaction scripts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: route a targeted edit from known file types.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve a Mixed Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect runtime and editor UI patterns in this mixed Unity project. Recommend separate routes for a HUD edit and a new editor window.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: distinguish framework choices across project contexts.

output_examples.input: My Unity inventory screen uses UXML and USS. Which skill should handle a layout change?
output_examples.output: Route to ui-uitk because UXML and USS identify UI Toolkit. Limit the change to the requested layout adjustment.

output_examples.input: I need a new game menu, have no framework preference, and have no existing UI.
output_examples.output: Use ui-ugui for this new runtime menu. Keep the scope to visual layout unless interaction scripts are explicitly requested.

output_examples.input: Can this skill import my Figma design URL automatically?
output_examples.output: Automated Figma import is unavailable here. Provide a screenshot or description, then select a Unity framework before routing implementation.

best_practices: Provide framework names, relevant file types, and whether the request targets runtime UI or editor tools.
Check existing project patterns before accepting a default framework recommendation.
State whether you need explanation, a targeted visual edit, or generation, and explicitly request any interaction scripts.
anti_patterns: Treating this routing skill as a replacement for the specialized implementation skills.
Using one framework choice for every runtime and editor request in a mixed project.
Expecting automatic Figma import or interaction scripts from a visual layout request.

faq.question: Does this skill implement Unity UI directly?
faq.answer: It answers conceptual questions and routes implementation requests to separate UI Toolkit, uGUI, or IMGUI skills.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Project-specific routing also requires access to the relevant project files.

faq.question: Which framework is the default for a new runtime interface?
faq.answer: The skill defaults to uGUI when there is no existing runtime UI pattern and the user has no framework preference.

faq.question: How does it choose a framework for editor tools?
faq.answer: It checks existing editor patterns first and defaults to UI Toolkit when no pattern exists. IMGUI is reserved for explicit requests or exclusively IMGUI projects.

faq.question: Can I use a Figma URL for automatic import?
faq.answer: No. This skill suggests using a screenshot or description instead, then routing the request to the appropriate framework skill.

faq.question: Were the referenced implementation skills included in the security audit?
faq.answer: No. Only this package's SKILL.md was reviewed. The referenced specialized skills are absent and require separate review.
